{{Short description|Professor}}
'''Jinichi Nagumo''' (南雲仁一, 1926 -- March 10, 1999) was a professor at the [[University of Tokyo]], known for his contributions to [[nonlinear dynamics]], mathematical modeling of neural systems, [[nonlinear oscillation]], and engineering. The [[FitzHugh–Nagumo model]] for neuron dynamics is named after him and [[Richard FitzHugh]].<ref>{{Cite journal |last=修治 |first=吉澤 |date=1999 |title=南雲仁一先生追悼 |url=https://www.jstage.jst.go.jp/article/jnns/6/3/6_3_142/_article/-char/ja/ |journal=日本神経回路学会誌 |volume=6 |issue=3 |pages=142–143 |doi=10.3902/jnns.6.142|doi-access=free }}</ref>
